source_id: ## 0. Starting a session and the standing owner rules — read first
note: Lives on as CLAUDE.md section 2 (live state) and rules 7, 11, 13, 14. Rule 4 'push to origin main' is suspended by D-13 (C-08). Lessons (tick_task prefix, 2-chunk regression, SC-F702 rerun, per-frame state) are in AC-19.

source_id: ## 1. Mission and order of operations
note: D-01, D-02 (C-01): 25 separately built apps become experiences of one app, 100 at launch. D-07, D-08 (C-04): the 25-app lock and 75 device rows become ImplementationLock-100 and 300 rows. Kept: no device before the lock.

source_id: ## 2. Operating Claude Desktop
note: Binding: Auto mode without bypass, one writing session, at most 10 agents, one writer per file, one Xcode lane, no self-spawning schedules, foreground builds of 10 minutes or less, never stop. Optional scheduled task.

source_id: ## 3. Governing documents and conflicts
note: D-10 (C-09): Auto-Creator.md, ADR-0009 and the bootstrap CLAUDE.md replace the README chapters and this contract in the precedence order. Carried: toolchain behaviour first; never drop a hard requirement (D-14).

source_id: ## 4. Hard architecture boundaries
note: Binding (D-09): GLES via ANGLE-Metal only, no second renderer or public EGL bridge; projectm-ios pinned read-only; Vendor/angle untouched; ProjectM out of the API; reuse rules in AC-13. Per-app targets end with D-01.

source_id: ## 5. Public API, privacy, licensing and safety rules
note: Binding: public Apple APIs only (no dlopen/dlsym, no ReplayKit workarounds); 10-minute non-silent device export before any audio-source claim; owner-provisioned signing; licence records; built-app privacy manifest audit.

source_id: ## 6. Exact three-device acceptance matrix
note: D-08 keeps D1 iPhone15,4, D2 iPad17,3 and D3 iPad15,7 (never updated from iPadOS 26.5) in that order; 25 apps per device (75 rows) become 100 experiences per device (300 rows, C-04). The roster is final.

note: Binding: installed speckit-* skills run in the Desktop session with the verbatim prompt plus 'Canonical override:' notes, one feature per gate, converge loop until nothing is appended. D-11 extends the numbering.

source_id: ## 8. Implementation campaign: development checks allowed, device tests not allowed
note: D-07, D-12 (C-04): the order F00-F09, 175 app gates, implementation lock becomes the 100-experience simulator gate; push to origin main is suspended by D-13 (C-08). Kept: host and simulator checks only before the lock.

source_id: ## Playbook: a new iOS app with Claude and Spec Kit, little human interaction (2026-11-10)
note: Container of the lessons the owner wants integrated: Spec Kit and simulator AC-19; setup, CI, release, owner actions AC-24; StoreKit AC-14; devices AC-23; performance AC-12. Their home is now Auto-Creator.md (D-10).

source_id: ### Owner rules and standing approvals (ask once, record here)
note: Carry: commit per task or skill with 'Feature NNN Txxx: change' subjects, no trailers, owner's git email, LF, [skip ci] only on docs-only pushes, dated owner rulings, owner-only list. Push approval: history (D-13).

source_id: ### Spec Kit flow (one feature, start to finish)
note: Carry: guidance with a ready prompt per command first; eight skills in order; per-feature id ranges checked by validate_docs.py (D-11 here); {device} and {owner} tags closed honestly; an agent report is not evidence.

source_id: ### Project setup that keeps humans out
note: Carry: XcodeGen with gitignored .xcodeproj, logic in Packages/ (AC-16), Signing.xcconfig '#include?' pattern, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO off-device, name before the permanent bundle id, version keys in prebuilt frameworks.

source_id: ### CI (GitHub Actions, `.github/workflows/ios-ci.yml`)
note: Carry: concurrency with cancel-in-progress and timeout-minutes on every job, fast docs and compliance gate, cached xcframework builds, XcodeGen pinned by SHA-256, simulator by runtime, gh run watch <id> --exit-status.

source_id: ### Testing on the Mac (simulators)
note: Carry: xcodebuild output to a log file, -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 180, hang triage, simctl privacy reset and erase, XCUITest pitfalls. SKTestSession isolation rules go to AC-14.

source_id: ### Automated device testing (devicectl, no Xcode UI)
note: Carry: runner under DEBUG || *_AUTOMATION started by *_AUTORUN, nm -U check, devicectl list, install, launch and copy commands, hardwareProperties.udid for xcodebuild, 200 samples, CADisplayLink meter, thinning report.

source_id: ### App Store Connect and release
note: Carry into UA-F14: early name check (OD-01), icon, ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption, privacy manifest of the built app, privacy policy URL, EULA, review notes, exact-size screenshots, Paid Apps agreement. No agent-run ASC.

source_id: ### Performance lessons from feature 002
note: Carry: readiness means what the user needs (local entitlement, not the price); parallel start-up work (async let); build-time data in display order; load and first frame measured separately. The D1 timings are history.

source_id: # VisualCore Application Brainstorm
note: Title and metadata (status: exploration and planning, 2026-11-09). All 25 concepts later became mandatory and are now the free experiences A01-A25 (ADR-0009 D-02).

source_id: ## 1. Executive Summary
note: The portfolio of separate applications became registered experiences in one app (ADR-0009 D-01). The principle 'different capabilities of one engine, not ProjectM variants' still holds.

source_id: ## 2. Existing Technical Foundation
note: Section heading. The ANGLE-backed foundation was audited (gate F00) and wrapped by VisualCoreRendering.RenderHost (gate F02); see the subsections.

source_id: ### 2.1 Rendering architecture
note: Stack as built: app code, VisualCore modules, RenderHost over EGL, ANGLE Metal backend (ADR-0002, gate F02, docs/architecture/visualcore-architecture.md). The app boxes in the diagram are now experiences.

source_id: ### 2.2 Important architectural decisions
note: All eight decisions are in constitution I, II and II-a and were followed in gates F00-F09 (ADR-0002, ADR-0003). Native Metal stays excluded without a test-backed ADR (ADR-0009 D-09).

source_id: ### 2.3 VisualCore's intended role
note: Built as optional modules driven by real consumers, not a game engine: 15 Swift modules in two packages (gates F01-F09, extended in A01-A04; API baseline docs/api/visualcore-public-api.txt).

source_id: ## 3. Application Idea Catalog
note: 'Concepts, not commitments' no longer holds: all 25 are launch experiences in the free tier (ADR-0009 D-02). The concept texts are carried in docs/catalog/experience-catalog.json.

source_id: ### 3.1 Creative and visual applications
note: Family of A01-A05 (launcher category create). A01-A03 are complete standalone apps, A04 is partial, A05 is not started; all five still need their integration gates X-A01 to X-A05.

source_id: #### 1. Generative Art Studio
note: A01: standalone app sealed by gates A01-P00 to A01-P06 (specs/011 to specs/017), simulators only. Adoption as experience a01.generative-art-studio (UA-F07, X-A01) and device rows are pending.

source_id: #### 2. Fluid Art Playground
note: A02: standalone app sealed by gates A02-P00 to A02-P06 (specs/018 to specs/024), simulators only. Integration gate X-A02 and device rows are pending.

source_id: #### 3. Fractal Explorer
note: A03: standalone app sealed by gates A03-P00 to A03-P06 (specs/025 to specs/031), simulators only. Integration gate X-A03 and device rows are pending.

source_id: #### 4. Particle Universe
note: A04: gates A04-P00 to A04-P03 are sealed (specs/032 to specs/035); A04-P04 to A04-P06 and X-A04 are pending. Particles are simulated on the CPU and drawn instanced, not simulated on the GPU.

source_id: #### 5. Infinite Geometry
note: A05: not started (gates A05-P00 to A05-P06, specs 039-045). Needs procedural meshes and 3D camera work beyond today's plane, cube and sphere generators and the single-mesh MeshRenderer.

source_id: ### 3.2 Music, audio, and entertainment
note: Family of A06-A09 (launcher category audio). None started. A06-A08 need VisualCoreAudio and VisualCoreAudioDSP, which are placeholders today (ADR-0006).

source_id: #### 6. VisualCore Music Lab
note: A06: not started (specs 046-052). Depends on microphone and in-app audio taps and FFT features that do not exist yet (ADR-0006). Capture of other apps' audio stays excluded.

source_id: #### 7. Audio Odyssey
note: A07: not started (specs 053-059). Needs audio features and a depth-buffered 3D scene path that the framework lacks. 'Scene packs' must not become paid add-ons (ADR-0009 D-03).

source_id: #### 8. Oscilloscope Studio
note: A08: not started (specs 060-066). Line primitives exist; audio acquisition and waveform buffers do not. Microphone claims need device evidence, which comes only after the lock (ADR-0006 item 3, D-07).

source_id: #### 9. Digital Aquarium
note: A09: not started (specs 067-073). Fish, plants and habitats must be procedural (ADR-0009 D-09). The framework has flat 2D primitives and instanced particles but no textured sprite batch.

source_id: ### 3.3 Games and interactive experiences
note: Family of A10-A13 (launcher category play). None started. The framework has no collision or physics module yet.

source_id: #### 10. Neon Arcade
note: A10: not started (specs 074-080). Fixed-step loop, touch input and particles exist; collision rules, sound, haptics and game-controller input do not (controllers: ADR-0006).

source_id: #### 11. Physics Playground
note: A11: not started (specs 081-087). Needs a deterministic rigid-body and spring solver; nothing of that kind exists in VisualCoreSimulation yet.

source_id: #### 12. Tiny Worlds
note: A12: not started (specs 088-094). Needs depth-buffered 3D, materials and procedural meshes. 'Collectible environments' must remain free content of the free tier (ADR-0009 D-03).

source_id: #### 13. Light Maze
note: A13: not started (specs 095-101). A pure ray and reflection solver with level fixtures is to be built; render targets, shaders and touch input exist.

source_id: ### 3.4 Education and scientific visualization
note: Family of A14-A17 (launcher category learn). None started. Scientific content needs cited sources and units (constitution X); geometry must be generated by code (ADR-0009 D-09).

source_id: #### 14. Solar System Explorer
note: A14: not started (specs 102-108). Needs depth-buffered 3D spheres with materials and an orbit model with stated accuracy; planet surfaces must be procedural (ADR-0009 D-09).

source_id: #### 15. Molecular Explorer
note: A15: not started (specs 109-115). Needs instanced mesh drawing (only particles are instanced today), 3D picking and a bounded, fuzz-tested molecule parser.

source_id: #### 16. Simulation Lab
note: A16: not started (specs 116-122). The field passes, ping-pong targets and CPU reference grids built for A02 (FieldPass, PingPongTarget, FieldGrid) are the starting point.

source_id: #### 17. Interactive Anatomy
note: A17: not started (specs 123-129). Open conflict: the concept needs anatomical 3D models and textures, while ADR-0009 D-09 excludes human-made or purchased models and D-02 forbids substitution.

source_id: ### 3.5 Ambient, personalization, and lifestyle
note: Family of A18-A21 (launcher category ambient). None started. Long-running thermal and battery behavior can only be proven on devices, after the lock (ADR-0009 D-07).

source_id: #### 18. Ambient Clock
note: A18: not started (specs 130-136). Text stays native SwiftUI over the GL scene (no glyph renderer exists). 'Premium themes' contradicts the free tier and the single purchase (ADR-0009 D-03).

source_id: #### 19. Living Wallpapers
note: A19: not started (specs 137-143). Offscreen still export exists (RenderHost.renderOffscreen, A01-P04); video export does not. No live home-screen wallpaper claim (constitution VIII).

source_id: #### 20. Digital Zen Garden
note: A20: not started (specs 144-150). Touch input, feedback targets and DocumentStore persistence exist and are to be reused.

source_id: #### 21. Aurora
note: A21: not started (specs 151-157). The noise GLSL library and particles exist. 'Optional soundscapes' would need procedural audio output, which the framework does not have.

source_id: ### 3.6 Developer and creator tools
note: Family of A22-A25 (launcher category tools). None started. User-authored shaders and graphs must be bounded and cycle-checked (constitution IX).

source_id: #### 22. Shader Studio
note: A22: not started (specs 158-164). ShaderLibrary and line-mapped diagnostics exist; user GLSL needs size, time and memory limits and a last-good fallback. Sharing must work without an account (D-03).

source_id: #### 23. Visual Programming Lab
note: A23: not started (specs 165-171). EffectGraphValidator (cycle rejection, quotas) is the base; a typed node-graph model and its serialization are new.

source_id: #### 24. Graphics Benchmark Lab
note: A24: not started (specs 172-178). Its core value, GPU performance measurement, is device-only: under ADR-0009 D-07 it ships simulator-verified methods with results pending hardware verification.

source_id: #### 25. Effects Composer
note: A25: not started (specs 179-185). Builds on VisualCoreEffects (eight pass types, limits of 32 passes and 256 MiB), Preset and offscreen export. User image import needs image decoding, which does not exist.

source_id: ## 6. VisualCore Capability-to-Application Validation Matrix
note: Of 15 capabilities, 9 are sealed (EGL lifecycle, shaders, framebuffers, feedback, particles, gestures, offscreen, effect graph, presets). Sprites, 3D scenes, materials, audio, GPU profiling, assets are not.

source_id: ### 6.1 Acceptance principle
note: Still the rule for every framework capability: a real consumer, a behavioral contract, tests, a sample, lifecycle and error behavior, measurements and documentation (constitution II).

source_id: ## 7. Proposed VisualCore Module Ecosystem
note: The nine candidate areas were regrouped into the modules of two packages by ADR-0003 and package-map.md. The subsections name where each area lives today.

source_id: ### 7.1 VisualCore Runtime
note: RenderHost, EGLDisplayProvider, RenderView, FrameScheduler and the RenderLifecycle states (gate F02, specs/003-rendering-lifecycle); simulators only.

source_id: ### 7.2 VisualCore Graphics
note: ShaderProgram, Texture, GPUBuffer, RenderTarget, GLState, MeshRenderer, PrimitiveRenderer (gates F03, F05). No material system, and no depth or stencil attachment on targets or the window surface.

source_id: ### 7.3 VisualCore Effects
note: Blur, bloom, distortion, color matrix, feedback, composite, copy and flash-limit passes (gate F04, specs/005-effects-graph); the graph model is in VisualCoreEffectsGraph.

source_id: ### 7.4 VisualCore Animation
note: No module of that name: Timeline, Tween, SceneClock and FixedStepRunner here, EasingCurve and TourTimeline in VisualCoreMath (gates F05, A01-P02, A03-P04). No scene-transition service.

source_id: ### 7.5 VisualCore Particles
